I’m 23 weeks in using this app and it is my most important tool. I came to brain.fm for the variety and I stayed because I found I can actually focus. 

I’ve tried several things to calm my monkey mind and give it something to occupy itself with while I work, read or plan. I’ve had a waterfall on my desk physically and monitor virtually , I’ve listened to classical music (thank you Mozart), I’ve listened to white noise, tried brown noise, and I even bought an album with nothing but the sounds of a coffee shop (a favorite by the way) I’ve listened to more audiobooks than I can count(for the more repetitive tasks).  I’ve even tried working on my computer in VR to shut out distractions (how much battery do I have left?)

I tried brain.fm because the coffee shop was getting old but I’ve found that (coupled with noise canceling headphones or even regular earbuds), I can sit at the kitchen table in the middle of life happening and still focus on what I’m doing.  Where my wife walking by used to throw me off, now I barely notice.  It’s almost like VR. I’ve also been attacking my distractibility from other angles but, I was using brain.fm before that. 

As I’ve used it I gradually added in or took away certain sounds. I’ve liked what I liked and thumb downed what I didn’t (the evil drone didn’t work for me) I’ve done the meditation, I tried sleep but it pulled a Pink Floyd Dark Side of the Moon and scared me awake after lulling me off, easily fixable with a thumb down. 

Thank you guys for a great app and the work you’ve put into it. If the science is just a scam don’t tell me about it because it’s been working great for me.  I suspect there has to be something to the science though because every now and then I stop and realize “I’ve been working on this for 2 hours?”

This app is totally essential for me! I have ADHD and it really helps me focus almost the second I turn it on. Its the perfect mix of music and nature sounds, better than anything else I’ve found. It also calms me down in anxious moments and is great for meditation. I use it multiple times a day so the subscription is worth it to me. Highly recommend!
